dedupe_keys.name: awesome climate scenarios over the nile river basin

description: The AWESOME project deposits downscaled and bias-adjusted climate scenarios over ten Nile River sub-basins. Its own page identifies daily precipitation in millimetres per day and mean, minimum and maximum temperature in degrees Celsius. It distinguishes a 1981 to 2005 control period, with temperature starting in 1983, from RCP2.6, RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 futures for 2006 to 2100. Zenodo lists a public ZIP of aggregated text data and a report under CC BY 4.0. These inputs could drive simulations of reservoir inflow, irrigation demand or climate exposure of water infrastructure. The page also mentions gridded NetCDF at an external POLIMI server, but those files are not in Zenodo’s public inventory and that server was not checked. CORDEX, CHIRPS and CHIRTS are upstream inputs with separate provenance. These are modelled climate scenarios, not local measurements. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this sub-basin release. The ZIP and report were not downloaded.
